lines: d17: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Angelo Adamczyk is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d17: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d17: 🕯️ Angelo Adamczyk is dead — dehydration. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d17: What Angelo kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d17: "Angelo's gone." Sergio looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Angelo." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d17: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Victor blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d17: 📖 LEARNED: Camp Cooking (Level 1). Cooking uses half the water, +10% kcal. Once per day: add a Secret Ingredient (a random inventory item) — 50% delicious (+morale), 50% educational.
d17: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d17: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d17: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d17: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d17: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d17: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Angelo Adamczyk, 17 days. The mantle passes to Victor Hayes.
d17: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Victor Hayes, 43 — a Baker. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper.
d17: The village's quarrel was with Angelo — and Angelo is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d17: At the grave, Sergio, Jaxon, Ruia and 2 more speak for Victor — "Angelo trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d17: The fire knew Victor before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
